hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Find any source form in which MWCC emits the `addi r0,r3,LO(lbl_801200B0)` BEFORE the pbLoad load without changing the instruction count. If a form that only reorders source statements moves that one word, the residual is source-reachable and this framing dies. A cheap first test: give the volatile read a real (used) destination so it acquires a data dependency on the base register.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes -- the aligned view `fnasm game/ui/select update_class_spec 0x298:0x2c0 --diff` was read after every probe; the single displaced word and the r0/r3/r4 recolors that follow from it are read directly off those bytes.
hypothesis.statement: The last instruction is scheduler-internal: MWCC is free to hoist the volatile SDA load past pure address arithmetic, so no source ORDERING can push it later, and closing it needs a one-word instruction_permutation rule rather than a source edit. The function is a permutation-class candidate at equal counts (217/217, multiset IDENTICAL, real 8).
